name: Perception Test 2023
description: The First Perception Test challenge was held as a half-day workshop alongside the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) 2023, with the goal of benchmarking state-of-the-art video models on the recently proposed Perception Test benchmark. The challenge had six tracks covering low-level and high-level tasks, with both a language and non-language interface, across video, audio, and text modalities, and covering: object tracking, point tracking, temporal action localisation, temporal sound localisation, multiple-choice video question-answering, and grounded video question-answering. We summarise in this report the task descriptions, metrics, baselines, and results.
evaluation_method: task-specific metrics (tracking metrics, mAP for localization, accuracy for multiple-choice VQA, etc.)
general_score_metric: task-specific (no single unified metric; e.g., mAP / tracking scores / accuracy)
reputation: Introduced as an ICCV 2023 workshop/challenge benchmark; used by participants of the Perception Test challenge but not yet a widely adopted community standard.
notes: Multimodal benchmark with heterogeneous tracks and metrics; relatively small/competition-focused datasets per track; results are track-dependent and not directly comparable across tasks.
